name: ArthaAI Institutional Financial Benchmark v2 (40 Scenarios, 5 Personas)

scenarios.name: Reliance Industries 5Y Integrated Capital Allocation & O2C Multiples
scenarios.question: Evaluate 5-year capital allocation, O2C margin outlook, and retail/telecom cash conversion for Reliance Industries.
scenarios.ground_truth_evidence: SEBI LODR Regulation 44 21-day notice for shareholder meetings. Finance Act 2024 revised STT schedule: delivery STT 10 bps, derivative STT 2 bps. Reliance 5Y historical OHLCV closing at ₹1438.30 with 23.4% annualized volatility.

scenarios.name: Tata Motors EV Segment Margin Cannibalization & JLR Free Cash Flow
scenarios.question: Stress-test Tata Motors valuation against European EV demand contraction, JLR capex commitments, and domestic commercial vehicle replacement cycles.
scenarios.ground_truth_evidence: SEBI LODR 2015 Reg 44 compliance. Finance Act 2024 delivery STT 10 bps, total roundtrip friction 22.22 bps. JLR EBIT margin expansion target 8.5% with peak-to-trough historical drawdown of 38.4%.

scenarios.name: HDFC Bank Post-Merger NPA Recognition & Net Interest Margin Pressure
scenarios.question: Audit post-merger mortgage integration, CASA ratio trends, liquidity coverage ratios, and statutory credit provisioning adequacy for HDFC Bank.
scenarios.ground_truth_evidence: RBI Master Direction on Prudential Norms on Income Recognition and Asset Classification. SEBI LODR Regulation 44 remote e-voting 21 days notice. HDFC Bank NIM compressed to 3.45% post merger.

scenarios.name: TCS vs Infosys Attrition, Margin Defensibility & Generative AI Capex
scenarios.question: Perform quantitative pairs analysis of TCS vs Infosys across operating margin defensibility, dollar revenue momentum, and voluntary attrition.
scenarios.ground_truth_evidence: TCS EBIT margin 26.0% vs Infosys 21.2%. Attrition rate 12.1% (TCS) vs 14.8% (Infosys). Finance Act 2024 STT 10 bps delivery equity friction. Ledoit-Wolf covariance shrinkage applied.

scenarios.name: State Bank of India (SBIN) Sensitivity to RBI Repo Rate Cut & Treasury MTM
scenarios.question: Model SBIN earnings sensitivity, modified duration of AFS/HFT bond portfolios, and loan re-pricing lag under an impending 50 bps RBI repo rate easing cycle.
scenarios.ground_truth_evidence: RBI Monetary Policy Committee resolution stance. SBIN Gross NPA 2.24%, Net NPA 0.57%. Treasury investment book modified duration 1.84 years. Statutory friction 22.22 bps roundtrip.

scenarios.name: Sun Pharma USFDA Halol Warning Letter & Taro Restructuring
scenarios.question: Evaluate USFDA regulatory inspection remediation costs, Taro complete buyout synergies, and specialty drug revenue contribution for Sun Pharma.
scenarios.ground_truth_evidence: USFDA Form 483 inspection observations. SEBI LODR 2015 Reg 44 advance notice. Sun Pharma Global Specialty revenue reached 18.5% of total sales. STT 10 bps delivery.

scenarios.name: Bharti Airtel ARPU Inflection, 5G Capex Peak & Indus Towers Lease Drag
scenarios.question: Assess mobile tariff hike transmission, free cash flow inflection post peak 5G network rollout, and return on capital employed for Bharti Airtel.
scenarios.ground_truth_evidence: TRAI monthly subscriber report. Indian wireless ARPU crossed ₹211. Finance Act 2024 STT 10 bps. Free cash flow generation expected to double over 3 years.

scenarios.name: Larsen & Toubro Mega Order Book Execution & Working Capital Cycle
scenarios.question: Analyze L&T consolidated order book of ₹4.8 lakh crore, Middle East hydrocarbon project execution margins, and domestic infrastructure ordering velocity.
scenarios.ground_truth_evidence: SEBI LODR 2015 Reg 44 notice. L&T working capital to sales ratio stable at 16.2%. Delivery STT 10 bps. Core EPC operating margin 8.6%.

scenarios.name: ITC Hotels Demerger Ratio & FMCG Margin Resilience
